top_signals.title: Bessent’s political turn in GOP speech tests his bond-market credibility
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's planned Republican convention speech in Dallas is raising questions about how politics could affect market confidence in him.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bessent’s Upsized Buybacks Get Hit by Treasury-Market Reality
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s unusual move to supersize his department’s debt buyback program stumbled on Wednesday, when an announcement on the size of the first enlarged operation proved insufficient to halt market declines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Husband & Wife Explore Sale of $37B Credit Firm
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Matt Monks joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Palmer Square Capital Management is a $37 billion credit firm run by the husband-wife duo Chris and Angie Long. And the couple is exploring a sale of the business. Under their leadership, the firm has grown to become one of the biggest issuers of collateralized loan obligations. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Met Police investigates Reform UK over potential breach of electoral law
top_signals.summary: The Metropolitan Police has launched a formal criminal investigation into Reform UK over potentially illegal foreign donations after top party officials were filmed facilitating the acceptance of payments via a middle man.  Detectives will look into the party’s funding following the undercover sting operation by Channel 4 News.   The police were called to act by [...]
